' grove-collection/1 {"version": 1, "name": "Six fields", "singular": "Six field", "fields": [{"name": "field0", "type": "Text", "key": "f0", "choices": [], "target": "", "role": "", "writable": true, "unit": ""}, {"name": "field1", "type": "Text", "key": "f1", "choices": [], "target": "", "role": "", "writable": true, "unit": ""}, {"name": "field2", "type": "Text", "key": "f2", "choices": [], "target": "", "role": "", "writable": true, "unit": ""}, {"name": "field3", "type": "Text", "key": "f3", "choices": [], "target": "", "role": "", "writable": true, "unit": ""}, {"name": "field4", "type": "Text", "key": "f4", "choices": [], "target": "", "role": "", "writable": true, "unit": ""}, {"name": "field5", "type": "Text", "key": "f5", "choices": [], "target": "", "role": "", "writable": true, "unit": ""}]}

#import lede=sys/lede
#import text=lib/grove/types/text


f0 =
  @slot

arg_f0 =
  @slot

f1 =
  @slot

arg_f1 =
  @slot

f2 =
  @slot

arg_f2 =
  @slot

f3 =
  @slot

arg_f3 =
  @slot

f4 =
  @slot

arg_f4 =
  @slot

f5 =
  @slot

arg_f5 =
  @slot

record =
  @role
  #opt ;
    %/f0: text
    %/f1: text
    %/f2: text
    %/f3: text
    %/f4: text
    %/f5: text

accepts =
  ! foil
  | grove_binding_contract
  \ inputs=row[myth]
  ^ either[str unit]
  ? !(eq inputs.len 0) (./err "This collection owns its fields.")
  | ./ok []

realize =
  ! foil
  | grove_realization
  \ inputs=row[myth] current=myth
  ^ myth
  | current.put(['sys 'lede] (pails/t "Six fields"))


save_all =
  @slot
  #meta ;
    "/sys/grove/action_handler": (grove_action_handler save_all/apply)
  ! foil
  + apply
    \ arguments=myth current=myth
    ^ maybe[myth]
    < f0 arguments.get([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'arg_f0])
    < f0 (text/read f0)
    < current (save_all/put_f0 current f0)
    < f1 arguments.get([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'arg_f1])
    < f1 (text/read f1)
    < current (save_all/put_f1 current f1)
    < f2 arguments.get([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'arg_f2])
    < f2 (text/read f2)
    < current (save_all/put_f2 current f2)
    < f3 arguments.get([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'arg_f3])
    < f3 (text/read f3)
    < current (save_all/put_f3 current f3)
    < f4 arguments.get([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'arg_f4])
    < f4 (text/read f4)
    < current (save_all/put_f4 current f4)
    < f5 arguments.get([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'arg_f5])
    < f5 (text/read f5)
    < current (save_all/put_f5 current f5)
    | ./some current
  + put_f0
    \ current=myth f0=str
    ^ maybe[myth]
    ? (eq f0 "") (./some current.del([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'f0]).del([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'display_f0]))
    | ./some current.put([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'f0] (pails/t f0))
  + put_f1
    \ current=myth f1=str
    ^ maybe[myth]
    ? (eq f1 "") (./some current.del([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'f1]).del([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'display_f1]))
    | ./some current.put([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'f1] (pails/t f1))
  + put_f2
    \ current=myth f2=str
    ^ maybe[myth]
    ? (eq f2 "") (./some current.del([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'f2]).del([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'display_f2]))
    | ./some current.put([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'f2] (pails/t f2))
  + put_f3
    \ current=myth f3=str
    ^ maybe[myth]
    ? (eq f3 "") (./some current.del([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'f3]).del([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'display_f3]))
    | ./some current.put([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'f3] (pails/t f3))
  + put_f4
    \ current=myth f4=str
    ^ maybe[myth]
    ? (eq f4 "") (./some current.del([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'f4]).del([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'display_f4]))
    | ./some current.put([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'f4] (pails/t f4))
  + put_f5
    \ current=myth f5=str
    ^ maybe[myth]
    ? (eq f5 "") (./some current.del([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'f5]).del([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'display_f5]))
    | ./some current.put([($x 17) 'gov 'medium 'sixproof 'f5] (pails/t f5))

surface =
  @view
  #on ; %/record
  #for ; /sys/slot/detail
  card => {
    group(on = card, action = %/save_all, myth = {
      '/0x11/gov/medium/sixproof/arg_f0 = ""
      '/0x11/gov/medium/sixproof/arg_f1 = ""
      '/0x11/gov/medium/sixproof/arg_f2 = ""
      '/0x11/gov/medium/sixproof/arg_f3 = ""
      '/0x11/gov/medium/sixproof/arg_f4 = ""
      '/0x11/gov/medium/sixproof/arg_f5 = ""
    }) {
      input('/0x11/gov/medium/sixproof/arg_f0)
      input('/0x11/gov/medium/sixproof/arg_f1)
      input('/0x11/gov/medium/sixproof/arg_f2)
      input('/0x11/gov/medium/sixproof/arg_f3)
      input('/0x11/gov/medium/sixproof/arg_f4)
      input('/0x11/gov/medium/sixproof/arg_f5)
      action("save_all")
    }
  }

typing.coverage: Compiled surface role and explicit input positions; arbitrary Foil constraints remain executable source, not an inferred schema.
